data.subject: Local Ledger uranium research
data.body:
Azarias Capital Management’s June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in URG, IPI, and EU.

EU reported Q2 2026 revenue of $15.7M versus $3.7M a year earlier, up 328.4% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1500881/000162828026056452/0001628280-26-056452-index.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue using public records only, and can offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
